mapper.select: SELECT a.album_id, a.title, ac.circle_id, c.name AS circle_name, c.logo_url AS circle_logo_url, a.cover_url, a.info_title, a.info_content, a.price, a.publish_date, COALESCE(t.tag_list, '{}') AS tags, COALESCE(wf.track_count, 0) AS track_count FROM cart_items ci JOIN albums a ON ci.album_id = a.album_id LEFT JOIN album_circles ac ON a.album_id = ac.album_id LEFT JOIN circles c ON ac.circle_id = c.circle_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT array_agg(t2.name ORDER BY t2.tag_id) AS tag_list FROM album_tags at2 JOIN tags t2 ON at2.tag_id = t2.tag_id WHERE at2.album_id = a.album_id ) t ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM work_files wf2 WHERE wf2.album_id = a.album_id ) wf ON true WHERE ci.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_items (user_id, album_id) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{album_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND album_id = #{album_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND album_id = #{album_id}
